suggestions.message: EncodeDecodeRoundtripStatement remains a def Prop. Whole P19 acceptance is blocked. Compiling 418 or 434 named declarations is not acceptance.
decodeBytes_encodeModule_of_lex_and_parse still assumes h_lex and h_parse. General tokenization of TreeJson.encode and envelope/module scanner admission remain open.
parse_tokens_tree / parseTokens_tree_valid invert TreeJson.tokens under Valid, value-context, and depth 64. They do not prove tokenize (TreeJson.encode t) and do not admit encodeModule bytes.

parseTokens_exprToTreeJson and expr_tokens_end_to_end are genuine general recursive Expr token inverses on production encodeExpr. Extra TreeJson.depth ≤ 64 is not implied by ExprCanonical alone (lit mapping depth 2 vs ExprEnc.depth 1). Not a public-domain change to StructurallyAdmissibleIR.

packedValueToTreeJson has mapping and toJson only. No encode/valid theorems. Mapping is the inner bool/rat payload, not production encodePackedValue. Do not accept that all 14 listed types have all three theorems.

Section 4 claims 422 standard / 12 none. Actual 434 probe is 391 standard / 43 none (418: 390 standard / 28 none). R20 adds 75 theorems/lemmas, not 91 new theorems. Verify raw lines are 1659/2686; 1658 is wrong. General theorems use standard axioms, so without-axioms is false.
R19 did not contain parse_arr_tokensList_cons_cons or parse_obj_tokensObj_cons_cons. Missing finalSt quantification belongs to R20 development.

Nine raw-stream bindings hash-match. lake build DefiKernel is a named library target (0.784s cache replay, 1122 jobs), not unqualified full build. Independent rebuild was lake build DefiKernel.Certificates.Correspondence, 932 jobs, Correspondence 266s.

findings.issue: EncodeDecodeRoundtripStatement remains a def Prop quantifying every StructurallyAdmissibleIR ir to decodeBytes (encodeModule ir) = .ok ir. R20 does not prove that proposition. Full P19 acceptance stays false.

decodeBytes_encodeModule_of_lex_and_parse still assumes h_lex and h_parse. Compiling the theorem with standard axioms is not a proof of the premises. StructurallyAdmissibleIR is unchanged; TreeJson.Valid/depth are theorem hypotheses, not an extra public domain restriction.

R20 proves general nested array/object token inversion under TreeJson.Valid (array length 4096, key Nodup) and depth 64. Child fold success is derived from child validity/depth and size decrease. Value-expecting contexts, nested feedValue errors, object acc.reverse/key disjointness, and array cardinality are handled in the inductive invariants. This is not a finite example.

R20 proves actual production encodeExpr tree representation equality and a general token inverse for arbitrary recursive ExprEnc. R19 fixed base cases remain historical. Extra TreeJson.depth ≤ 64 is not implied by ExprCanonical alone.

Independent 418 = 106+311+lemma exprDepth_pos, 390 standard 28 none. Independent 434 = 418 plus 16 defs, 391 standard 43 none. Author section 4 422/12 is wrong. 75 new theorems/lemmas, not 91. Verify raw 1659/2686; 1658 is wrong. without-axioms is false.
PackedValue has mapping/toJson only. R19 did not contain the cons_cons lemmas; missing finalSt belongs to R20.
